content.comment_body: Hello, does anyone here have experience comparing the [product_name] modules like [product_name]? How do you find the stability of connections over OpenVPN? Thanks in advance for your input.
Perhaps this information is useful: Setting up a secure VPN connection between a PC and [product_name] [version_no].

Hello, In my experience, [product_name] modules do not perform as reliably as industrial alternatives, especially since remote rebooting is not feasible and it is almost required daily. Scheduled restarts are also not possible. Even very inexpensive routers provide these basic features. There are also issues with the SIM card filling up from received SMS messages, causing the module to stop accepting further ones. I advise against using these modules due to various problems. [user_name]

Hello, We are encountering major issues with the [product_name]—the VPN connection drops after a few hours. We suspect that a change in public IP breaks routing to DynDNS. Is anyone else experiencing this, or does anyone know of a solution? Best regards, [user_name]

Hello, Using a static public IP seems to work, especially when combined with the HTTPS protocol. However, the HTTPS port closes after some hours, and toggling VPN on/off helps. The bigger issue is with deleting received SMS; the module fails to prevent the memory from filling up, eventually stopping new SMS reception.

Hello, I have to say the SMS issue points to poorly designed firmware. Limiting the number of SMS messages saved to the card is a serious flaw—it's surprising for a company like [company_name]. I've experienced several installation problems due to this.
Hello, The [product_name] modules such as [product_name] and [product_name] have been extremely unreliable in my experience.

Hello [user_name], It may take a bit more time than usual, but I hope to provide a useful update soon. We've discussed these issues internally with product management, and your feedback would be greatly appreciated. Best regards,

analysis.insight_summary: Forum users report considerable dissatisfaction with the reliability and stability of the [product_name] modules, especially [product_name], highlighting recurring VPN disconnections, absence of remote reboot options, and ineffective management of SMS storage. The frequent need for manual intervention and inability to delete SMS messages automatically lead to operational downtime. Users mention that even low-cost routers often outperform these modules regarding basic functionality.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect stable VPN connectivity without interruptions, remote reboot capability, and automatic SMS storage management so devices do not lock up. They seek firmware reliability and feature sets matching those found in basic routers.
